say:1:1422693701:1.text: I can feel it from this sapling! It shares the same origin as the Lucent Tree!
say:1:1422693701:1.source_cn: 这棵树苗，我感觉到了！这是与流荧树同根同源的力量！

say:2:1422693702:1.text: The earth's energy is flowing back, slowly returning to Misarte's embrace...
say:2:1422693702:1.source_cn: 在它的引导下，整个萨洛克兰的地脉都开始逐渐归于弥萨忒的...

say:3:1422693703:1.text: And the people—this land—the Lucent Tree loves them still. I can feel it.
say:3:1422693703:1.source_cn: 而此处的人们，我已经能感到这棵流荧树的亲昵与钟爱了。

choice_prompt:4:1422693703.text: And the people—this land—the Lucent Tree loves them still. I can feel it.
choice_prompt:4:1422693703.source_cn: 而此处的人们，我已经能感到这棵流荧树的亲昵与钟爱了。

say:5:1422693704:1.text: Yes. Misarte is using her gentle power to nourish this long-dried land. We succeeded.
say:5:1422693704:1.source_cn: 是的，弥萨忒正在用祂的温柔滋润这片干涸已久的土地，我们...

say:6:1422693706:1.text: Indris? You seem troubled. Is there something wrong?
say:6:1422693706:1.source_cn: 怎么了，因度厄？你表情很沉重，还有什么隐患吗？

say:7:1422693707:1.text: No... I'm relieved. Truly. But that relief helped me notice something I had overlooked.
say:7:1422693707:1.source_cn: 不，我非常高兴，如释重负。但也正因此，我察觉了之前在重...

say:8:1422693708:1.text: When I saw the out-of-place elemental spirits before, I had a similar feeling, but it wasn't until just now when the curse was lifted, that I confirmed it.
say:8:1422693708:1.source_cn: 在之前看到格格不入的元素之灵时，我就有了类似的感觉，但...

say:10:1422693710:1.text: Thador's accusations against me weren't unfounded.
say:10:1422693710:1.source_cn: 所以，都铎对我的指责，有一部分是正确的。

say:11:1422693711:1.text: I was born here—an Essail—carrying dreams too bright for a world weighed down by loss. Dreams of the surface, of sunlight and peace.
say:11:1422693711:1.source_cn: 我是在萨洛克兰出生的艾塞勒，对地表上的生活充满着自以为...

say:12:1422693712:1.text: And in chasing those dreams, I wounded the very hearts that had already endured too much.
say:12:1422693712:1.source_cn: 而这份幻想，也确实侮辱了他们的情感。

say:13:1422693713:1.text: Seralyth, Velara, Thador, Sage Tasso... So many names are now consigned to memory.
say:13:1422693713:1.source_cn: 奈萨雷斯，奎茵，都铎，已经去世的塔萨贤者，以及更多古老...

say:14:1422693714:1.text: Their grief, their bitterness, their fear, their anger...
say:14:1422693714:1.source_cn: 悲痛的，憎恨的，屈辱的，冤屈的，恐慌的。

say:15:1422693715:1.text: But also, an incredibly clear and deeply nostalgic... homesickness.
say:15:1422693715:1.source_cn: ……但却又无比确切，无比怀念的……思乡之情。

say:16:1422693716:1.text: The surface life I fantasized about was the true homeland they were forced to leave, having gone astray under false guidance, carrying immense pain.
say:16:1422693716:1.source_cn: 我所幻想的地表，是他们曾经在错误的引导下走上歧途，背负...

say:17:1422693717:1.text: Maybe that's why Misarte chose to plant a new Lucent Tree here.
say:17:1422693717:1.source_cn: 嗯，我想，这也是弥萨忒为什么赐予这里一棵新的流荧树的缘故吧。

say:18:1422693718:1.text: If it were just about ending the punishment, she could have simply lifted the curse.
say:18:1422693718:1.source_cn: 如果只是赐福于此，或者想要召唤萨洛克兰的人们回归，祂只...

say:19:1422693719:1.text: But she did more. She reconnected the leylines and blessed this place with new roots.
say:19:1422693719:1.source_cn: 但祂连结这里的地脉，用新的流荧树作为祂的祝福。

say:20:1422693720:1.text: There were mistakes... false paths... But now, it leads to something new.
say:20:1422693720:1.source_cn: 错误的引导，错误的路途，错误的终点，但……会再次迎来正...

choice_prompt:21:1422693720.text: There were mistakes... false paths... But now, it leads to something new.
choice_prompt:21:1422693720.source_cn: 错误的引导，错误的路途，错误的终点，但……会再次迎来正确的开始。

say:22:1422693721:1.text: Yes. Sal'thorin was born from pain—and though led astray by the Hypogean, it endured.
say:22:1422693721:1.source_cn: 我想，萨洛克兰的建立，尽管违背了弥萨忒的意愿，甚至是在...

say:23:1422693722:1.text: A kingdom carved from sorrow, but still a kingdom of its own.
say:23:1422693722:1.source_cn: 但，在漫长的苦痛与折磨中，坚韧不拔地建立起了属于自己的国度。

say:24:1422693723:1.text: Even with hearts full of sorrow and unrest, their struggle must have reached Misarte.
say:24:1422693723:1.source_cn: 即使心怀憎恨与不满，但这份坚持与努力，弥萨忒一定是有所...

say:25:1422693724:1.text: Even if we lost our way, time and time again...
say:25:1422693724:1.source_cn: 尽管我们……在之后漫长的道路上，再次走错了方向。

say:26:1422693725:1.text: Now, this tree—this gift—will bring us dawn once more, and with it, a true new beginning.
say:26:1422693725:1.source_cn: 但是，这棵树会再次为我们带来曙光，再次迎来一个——正确...

say:28:1422693705:1.text: I can feel it too. Misarte is welcoming the lost back home. Everything is connected once again.
say:28:1422693705:1.source_cn: 是的，我能感到，弥萨忒正在拥抱着离去的游子，这里的一切...
